ns2:section.sectionText: This section meets mostly online, but may have occasional in-person meetings. You will be charged an Art + Design Facilities Fee which will grant you access to the Art + Design Facilities. The class will be taught mainly online with few meetings planned during the semester. The class requires the use of Adobe Software: AI and PS.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Graphic Design or Crafts or History of Art or Photography or Industrial Design or Painting or Sculpture or Art Education or Art Undeclared or New Media or Studio Art or Art and Art History or Sustainable Design major(s).
